title: Mu Zhan at the Banquet
summary: At the Nalan Clan's banquet for Nalan Jie's recovery, Ya Fei acts close to Yan Xiao in front of Nalan Yanran and then takes him to meet the guests. Nalan Su presents Nalan Jie, the Lionheart Commander of the Jia Ma Empire, and Mite'er Tengshan greets Yan Xiao warmly, which annoys Nalan Jie. Mu Zhan of the Mu Clan, back from the border army and obsessed with Ya Fei, attacks Yan Xiao to warn him off her. Xiao Yan holds his own until Mu Zhan summons Dou Qi Armor and Green Wooden Thorn, and Nalan Yanran stops the fight with her Thousand Wind Blade. Nalan Jie and Tengshan both warn Mu Zhan that Yan Xiao is their friend, and Mu Zhan backs off but says he looks forward to fighting again. Tengshan tells Ya Fei to take good care of Yan Xiao, and the two slip away from the banquet.
events: Ya Fei plays up her closeness to Yan Xiao in front of Nalan Yanran.
Nalan Su introduces Nalan Jie, the Lionheart Commander, to the guests.
Mite'er Tengshan greets Yan Xiao; Nalan Jie grumbles that Tengshan is courting him.
Liu Ling and Princess Yue Er watch, and Yue Er hints trouble is coming.
Mu Zhan attacks Yan Xiao over Ya Fei.
Mu Zhan summons Dou Qi Armor; Nalan Yanran breaks up the fight.
Nalan Jie and Tengshan warn Mu Zhan; Tengshan threatens to have Mu Chen send him back to the border.
introduced: Dou Qi Armor (exclusive to Da Dou Shi)
cultivation: Mu Zhan summons Dou Qi Armor, said to be exclusive to a Da Dou Shi. Nalan Yanran is said to have grown much stronger in three years (no rank given).
